initiatives.name: Goodwill Impairment of £488m Recognised
initiatives.summary: The Group recognised a goodwill impairment of £488m associated with the UK Digital, UK Retail, TAB NZ Digital and TAB NZ Retail cash generating units, driven by timing of local regulatory changes and competitive pressures. This reflects a significant downward revision in expected future cash flows from these business units.

initiatives.name: AUSTRAC Civil Penalty Provision Recognised
initiatives.summary: Entain recognised a £54m provision in FY25 related to the AUSTRAC civil penalty proceeding, reflecting regulatory action and compliance risk in its Australian operations (TAB NZ/Australia-related business). This represents a significant increase in litigation risk compared to FY24 when no such provision existed.
